_about: Readiness measures how ready a write-up is for outside use, not how good the story or the work is. The 12 tests are computed by readiness.py from the checked records; only the wording here can be changed in the settings workbook. The band comes from the rule below unless an override row (story, band, reason) is supplied.

items.1: Location: village, block and district written (a state inferred from the district is accepted)
items.2: Dates: start and end with a year, and working days stated
items.3: Participants: a total and a women/men split
items.4: Size: the work's size is given with a unit
items.5: Named resident voice: a named resident, in direct speech, with age stated
items.6: Decision moment shown: a person proposes or reasons are weighed
items.7: Goonj's role: Goonj named, how it came in stated, and what the team did described
items.8: Exchange: what families received (contents) and when
items.9: Result: at least one result with a stated time gap, and none asserted without a date
items.10: Voice integrity: no office-holder line standing in for residents, and more than reported speech
items.11: Sensitivity: no personal health, injury, bereavement or menstrual detail or community label left without a consent status
items.12: Consistency: one spelling per place, one size basis, no blank or varying code field, no year missing, no translation slip

bands.5: Publishable as it is after a copy-edit.
bands.4: Usable after light editing plus one field call.
bands.3: Usable with edits and a follow-up call: hard data present but voice, result or framing missing.
bands.1: Cannot be used outside in any form.

rule.band_2: Two or more of items 5, 6, 7 and 9 fail and Goonj is not named anywhere in the story.
rule.band_4: Items 1, 5, 10 and 11 pass, a total number of people is stated, and at most three of items 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 12 fail.
